configuration: 002 guarded pan and upper support on taps-02 chassis (pan-build r3 proposal)
architecture: Single-pivot guarded gravity pan with riveted sheet-and-tube cheeks, socket posts and a pivot bulkhead (no welds), on bolted 1 in X110/X250 upper cradles over the two-sill pan truss with a rear inlet truss node; starboard axial location with knee struts; passive high-loss stow stop on separate lug plate stacks, soft stop at -5 deg bolted through a keeper under the X250 cradle, a -3.5 deg opening-direction drive inhibit (limit cam and switch), a mandatory output slip clutch, and a torsion closing spring
status: Pre-CAD target roster r3 for review. It is not frozen until its SHA-256 is recorded under operatingIntent.articleFunctions in the approved commissioning plan.

functions.support-cradle: Bridge the upper pan stringers at X110 or X250. Carry journal, drive-reaction, stop and soft-stop loads to the stringers at the four upper pickup datums
functions.cradle-attach: Fix one cradle end to an Upper pan stringer inboard face beside a truss node
functions.journal-carrier: Hold a flanged 1/2 in hex bearing on the pan axis at Y=+/-195 and land on both cradle tops
functions.carrier-attach: Fix a bearing carrier or the gearbox plate to a cradle top
functions.axial-strut: Carry the starboard thrust (685 N guide case) from the carrier at Z=560 to the starboard stringer as axial strut force
functions.drive-mount: React the pan gearbox housing torque at the drive datum Y=216 and land on both cradles
functions.journal: Support the pan hex radially on the pivot axis (205, y, 580); ~446 N peak radial per side
functions.thrust: Locate the pan axially on the starboard (idler) side only: 396 N pipe peak, 685 N guide case
functions.drive: Supply pan torque at 54.83:1 (NEO 550; 5.23/3.62/2.90 stages) under the 30 A phase limit
functions.drive-shaft: Transmit gearbox output torque through the port bearing into the driven hex socket with axial slip
functions.drive-fastening: Retain the gearbox housing and output adapter (supplier screws)
functions.carry-floor: Carry the article on the 430 x 322 mm floor through receive, carry and tip (carried-forward profile)
functions.side-guide: Guide the article laterally (riveted sheet-and-tube cheek ladder) and present the soft-stop strike
functions.root-moment: Carry the cheek root moment (685 N x 145 mm at the post root) from the socket posts across the pan (pivot bulkhead and 1/4 in end clips bolted through both legs)
functions.stop-strike: Present the stow-stop striking face at the M1 contact (separate block, screwed and pinned through the cheek skin)
functions.rear-wall: Retain the article at stow (96 mm slot)
functions.pivot-socket: Couple the pan to the drive or idler 1/2 in hex and carry the cheek root moment (socket post)
functions.drive-protection: Limit the gearbox output torque to 16.5-18 N m (above the 15.4 N m normal-duty cap) in every drive fault and bumper strike
functions.drive-inhibit: Inhibit opening-direction drive output below theta = -3.5 deg; never cut closing output; never latch (controller reverse-limit input, coast)
functions.idler-shaft: Carry the starboard side of the pan through its bearing, thrust stack and closing spring
functions.pan-joint: Join the floor and lips to the cheeks without welding (T6/H32 tempers retained)
functions.pan-fastening: Retain a mechanically joined pan joint (blind rivet or flat-head screw)
functions.feed-surface: Deliver the station-fed article from the feed to the pan floor (sim feed polyline)
functions.inlet-guide: Constrain the article laterally on the fixed inlet (94 N fixed-inlet load)
functions.inlet-structure: Tie the fixed inlet guides and panels together
functions.inlet-support: Carry the fixed inlet to the stringer extensions
functions.inlet-truss: Carry the stringer extensions and inlet loads to the perimeter through the new rear truss node
functions.truss-node: Transfer member force between an existing truss member top and the upper stringer (plugged butt node, M9)
functions.stop-bracket: Locate the stow stop pad seat and react the +q stop load into the X110 cradle (design 2 x 296 N per pad, rear bumper strike)
functions.stop-backing: Bond the stow pad and set its seat with the shim stack (+/-0.05 deg at stow)
functions.stop-pad: Passive unilateral high-loss stow stop: 300 N/mm and 790 N s/m per pad at a 100 mm lever
functions.soft-stop: Passive open-direction stop at theta=-5 deg; absorbs the F1-F3 drive faults with the inhibit late and the front bumper strike (structure.json softStopStructure)
functions.soft-stop-pad: High-loss soft-stop pad, 18 mm, ~250 N/mm per pad at a 90 mm lever
functions.closing-preload: Passive 1.5 N m closing torque at stow, linear to zero at theta=-2 deg
functions.spring-mount: Locate and drive the closing torsion spring on the idler stub
functions.joint-fastening: Retain a bolted upper-support or inlet-truss joint
functions.blind-thread: Provide a #10-32 thread in a closed 1/16 in tube wall where no nut can be reached (blind rivet nut)
